arguments.Code:
using UnityEngine;using UnityEngine.UI;using InhaExpress.Client.Presentation;
internal class CommandScript : IRunCommand { public void Execute(ExecutionResult result) {var h=Object.FindFirstObjectByType<WebClientHud>();h.OperatorControls.DeselectVehicle();foreach(var d in h.GetComponentsInChildren<Dropdown>(true))if(d.name=="Dispatch Policy Dropdown")d.Show();ScreenCapture.CaptureScreenshot("artifacts/high_speed_drive/garage-dropdown-charging.png");foreach(var c in Object.FindObjectsByType<UnityAutonomousClient>(FindObjectsSortMode.None))result.Log(c.VehicleId+" reserved="+c.TransportReserved+" status="+c.Status);}}
